brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Palestinians participating in Israeli elections are prioritizing survival rather than expressing confidence in Israeli democratic institutions. The outlet noted that Palestinian electoral engagement occurs within what it characterizes as an apartheid system, with Palestinians facing structural constraints that extend beyond the voting booth.

The publication stated that Palestinian parliamentary representation does not eliminate the systemic inequalities Palestinians encounter under Israeli governance. Palestinian voters operate within material conditions that shape their political choices and lived experience.

title: Palestinians vote in Israeli elections amid apartheid conditions
